risks.risk: Storage capacity (1TB) may be incorrect; could be 500GB/other variant.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console’s bottom/side label showing model and storage capacity (or a dashboard storage screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest likely Xbox One S storage variant (treat as not confirmed 1TB).

risks.risk: Console may not work properly (disc drive issues, overheating, no power, controller pairing problems).
risks.proof: A short video clip of the console powering on to the Xbox dashboard and showing it can launch a game.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: not guaranteed fully working (discount accordingly).

risks.risk: Games installed may be different from what’s expected, or the account may be locked/region-restricted.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the installed games list on the dashboard (My games & apps) with the game titles visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no confirmed games included (treat as console only).

risks.proof: Photos of all included items laid out (power brick/cable, HDMI, controller charging cable if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only what’s shown: console + controller, with cables not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Controller condition (stick drift, button faults) not shown.
risks.proof: Video showing controller inputs working (e.g., moving cursor in dashboard) and a quick test of buttons/sticks.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller may need repair/has unknown wear (discount).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console label/sticker showing exact model and storage capacity (1TB confirmation).
Video of the console booting to the Xbox dashboard (power-on proof).
Photo/video of the installed games list (My games & apps) with titles visible.
Photos of all included accessories laid out (power cable/brick, HDMI, any other cables).
Video test of the controller (stick movement + button presses) to rule out drift/faults.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox One S-looking console and one controller, but key pricing drivers are unverified remotely: 1TB storage, whether games are actually installed, and whether everything works with the right accessories. Request the label and dashboard proof before pricing confidently.
